scope: hardened dependency-free persistent workflow runtime and real-input 27.5-second flower-video visual audit
summary: The v3 replay supersedes the first workflow record after runtime hardening: each node retry now receives an immutable attempt directory, nodes operate on detached state, and dynamic transitions fail closed; the same real 660-frame evidence completes seven nodes and eight checkpoints with all twelve scoped visual gates passing, three explicit quality debts, and no physical promotion.
evidence: outputs/workflows/20260813T024729Z-flower-long-video-v3/result.json binds the 27.5-second candidate and records all 12 scoped visual gates, two risk windows, three quality debts, and physical_promotion.eligible=false
outputs/workflows/20260813T024729Z-flower-long-video-v3/checkpoints/flower-27p5s-v3/checkpoints contains eight hashed checkpoints for the complete seven-node execution
outputs/workflows/20260813T024729Z-flower-long-video-v3/logs/events.jsonl records the streamed node lifecycle and terminal result
Ten targeted workflow, flower-contract, and perceptual-promotion tests pass after runtime hardening; targeted Ruff validation also passes
The broader local suite passed 811 tests with one optional MuJoCo skip before the final isolated runtime hardening, which is covered by the targeted suite
lessons: Retries and interrupt resumes need unique attempt directories so their command logs and artifacts never overwrite previous evidence.
Passing a detached state copy prevents an untrusted node from mutating the runtime state outside its declared update.
Dynamic goto targets must be validated before checkpointing so misspelled transitions fail at the originating node.
Flower insertion needs a domain-specific visible-contact gate, while projected image-space contact must remain explicitly non-physical.
limitations: This run audits an existing candidate; it does not contain a new model generation, training run, or measured generation-throughput improvement.

The accepted scope is perceptually plausible synthetic display data only; metric camera, exact q/qdot, persistent per-stem 3-D geometry, contact force, force closure, and real-robot execution remain unverified.
Two route-transition outliers remain at frames 479 and 559, and the legacy late hand-replacement proxy reports a 0.233333 violation fraction.
Other AC-WM, simulation, retargeting, and renderer CLIs have not all been migrated into built-in graph recipes.

Run the same sealed twelve-gate contract on those challengers and promote only a strict non-regression result.
